scientific_integrity: Direct proof of the all-parameter formula, uniqueness, affine invariance, and direct parabolic limit; finite verification is diagnostic only.
scientific_limitations: Dimension d>=2 and -1<a<1 for original bodies; separate limiting paraboloid.
The half-ball a=0 exact value and unique center were published by Belloni and Freund.
No claim of optimal rounding factor or independent historical priority.
A potentially equivalent older result might be unindexed.
title: Exact Minkowski symmetry and unique centers of all Euclidean ball truncations
